caption:
Your first bar cart, Large Sahab approved. 🥃

Five things, and you don’t even need a bottle yet: good tumblers, a jigger, big ice moulds, a water jug, and a proper chakna bowl.

Save this for your next ghar party. And DM a photo of your bar cart: Large Sahab will rate it.

Water between pegs.
